name: evascrape
description: Find business leads with email addresses from Google Maps, Apollo.io and LinkedIn.
long_description: Ask Claude for a lead list in plain words, for example "find 200 dentists in Austin with their emails". Evascrape runs the extraction on its own servers and returns structured records: names, companies, emails, phones, websites. Jobs are paid from a prepaid Evascrape balance (top-ups from $10, no free credit); estimate_cost prices a job before it starts. Requires an Evascrape API key from app.evascrape.com/account/api-keys.

tools.name: google_maps_leads
tools.description: Find local businesses and their contact details on Google Maps. Spends prepaid credit.

tools.name: apollo_export
tools.description: Export a people search you built on Apollo.io. Spends prepaid credit.

tools.name: linkedin_leads
tools.description: Build a list of people from LinkedIn audiences by filters. Spends prepaid credit.

tools.description: Check whether an extraction job has finished.

tools.description: Price a job before starting it, without charging.
